supersession_reason: The previous cohort failed the frozen target-strain evidence requirement. This protocol uses the evidence-qualified 324-molecule cohort and primary-study-disjoint folds.

features.scaling: StandardScaler fit on training partition only for logistic regression and RBF SVM; no scaling for random forest

models.probability_interpretation: scikit-learn built-in probability estimates using training-partition data; no post-hoc calibration

validation.method: immutable StratifiedGroupKFold assignments from protocol-mic-study-03 audit
validation.reporting: pooled OOF metrics and every fold metric; fold-wise mean is descriptive only; no confidence interval or formal inferential claim
validation.calibration: no post-hoc calibration or threshold selection; SVC uses its built-in probability estimation on the training partition

scope_limits: exploratory baseline only; not a formal model release or publication-ready result
the indivisible 249-molecule homology-and-study component remains intact in its assigned fold
five validation folds have 19, 18, 249, 19, and 19 molecules; the large-component fold has only 75 training molecules
no ESM embeddings, external holdout, model selection, threshold selection, post-hoc calibration, or post-hoc filtering
release_gate: Training requires matching hashes and feasible evidence plus study-disjoint manifests. It does not change the blocked status of the original dual-task formal study.
